name: Dizzasco (Italy)
description: White field with a red border, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Dizzasco within branches and the inscription COMUNE DI DIZZASCO in black arched above.
history: Municipal flag of Dizzasco, a comune in Lombardy; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Dizzasco arms — stars, a tree and a horse, crowned, within branches
inscription COMUNE DI DIZZASCO arched above the arms
